name: Sany Renewable Energy Co.,Ltd.
summary: Sany Renewable Energy Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of wind turbines and generators in China. The company operates through five segments: The Wind Turbine Manufacturing; The wind power services; Wind farm development; Power Plant Products Sales; and Others segments. It engages in the research and development, manufacturing and sales, maintenance and transportation services of wind turbines and their components; and provides wind power-related consulting and wind farm construction, as well as engages in wind farm development and operation.
